One status event POSTed by bench to /runs/{id}/events. The Job or process exit status stays the final authority.

Schema file: `schema/json/events.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `505d4f5b031c`.

## Top level

| Field      | Type                                                      | Required | Description                                                                               |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run_id`   | `string`                                                  | Yes      |                                                                                           |
| `sequence` | `integer`                                                 | Yes      | Starts at 0 and grows by one per event, so the API can order and de-duplicate. ≥ 0        |
| `time`     | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)   | Yes      |                                                                                           |
| `step`     | [pipelineStep](/reference/schemas/events/#pipelinestep)   | Yes      |                                                                                           |

| `phase`    | `string`                                                  | No       | Current phase while state is running during the load step, for example warmup or stage-2. |
| `message`  | `string`                                                  | No       |                                                                                           |

## Definitions

### pipelineStep

The seven steps of the run pipeline.

Type: `"resolve"`, `"snapshot"`, `"load"`, `"collect"`, `"normalize"`, `"summarize"`, `"finalize"`

### reportedState

The lifecycle states bench can report. pending, launching and cancelled belong to the API's runner.

Type: `"running"`, `"collecting"`, `"succeeded"`, `"failed"`
